McCrindle’s translation of the fragments of Megasthenes’ Indika and Arrian’s Indika, the Greek accounts of Mauryan India, with notes on caste, the city of Pāṭaliputra and the state (Calcutta, 1877). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised by Google from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Ancient India as described by Megasthenês and Arrian · Mégasthénès, E. A. Schwanbeck, Arrian, John Watson McCrindle · 1877, 247 scanned pages. Published 1877; John Watson McCrindle died 1913; Megasthenes and Arrian lived in antiquity; public domain in India.

The scans of this book are not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page was read from the scan by machine (OCR) for this library, and lightly cleaned; it may contain errors, and the scan of every page is one button away.
